battle.name: 阿卡德帝國的形成
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞中部（阿卡德）
battle.brief: 公元前二三三四年，阿卡德城邦的園丁之子薩爾貢奪得王位，以阿卡德為中心揮兵，攻破烏魯克、烏瑪、勒加什等蘇美爾城邦的城牆，又北取馬里、東滅埃蘭，把各自為政的城邦壓成一個王國。這場統一戰爭的骨幹是持矛的步兵：卡面的早王朝埃及長矛正屬同一類兵器，銅矛頭裝在木桿上，靠密集列陣取勝。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 阿卡德帝國的形成，是前二三三四年阿卡德城邦對蘇美爾諸城邦與其外圍勢力的一場體系性戰爭，雙方並非同族國家之間的全面戰爭，而是一個正在集結的城邦聯盟對另一個正在集結的城邦聯盟。阿卡德一方以國王薩爾貢為最高指揮，軍隊混合編成：阿卡德與蘇美爾的步兵、弓箭手，另有由四輪實心車輪輕型馬車承載的戰車隊，作為機動與指揮平台；薩爾貢在王璽銘文上自稱有「五千四百人」的常備軍，並以「不識敵人」自詡，說明其軍隊已不是臨時徵發的民兵。控制點在建於幼發拉河與卡班運河交會處的阿卡德城，並以尼普爾的恩利爾神廟為宗教中心，藉「大地之王」的名分吸納各城。蘇美爾一方是數十個各自為政的城邦：烏魯克、烏瑪、勒加什、烏爾、埃利都、基什等，各有城邦民兵、城牆與神廟經濟，由「恩西」總督主持市政，國王只是城邦國君，無權調動他城之兵。東面有埃蘭的安尚與蘇薩，中部幼發拉河上有馬里，北方山地有蘇巴爾圖的氏族與游牧集團。整場衝突的勝負，決定了美索不達米亞是走城邦聯盟的路，還是走帝國的路。
countriesEn: The formation of the Akkadian Empire was a systemic war fought in 2334 BC between the city-state of Akkad on one side and the Sumerian city-states together with the powers around them on the other. It was not a general war between two nations of one people, but a coalition of city-states facing another coalition of city-states. The Akkadian side was commanded personally by the king Sargon, and its army was mixed in composition: Akkadian and Sumerian infantry and archers, plus a war-chariot corps riding light four-wheeled chariots with solid disc wheels, which served as a mobile platform of command and shock. On his royal seal Sargon claimed a standing force of 5,400 men 'who knows no enemy', which shows the army was no longer a levy of citizens raised for the occasion. The hinge of his control was Akkad itself, the city he built near the junction of the Euphrates and the King Canal, while the temple of Enlil at Nippur remained the religious centre and the title 'king of the land' gave him the standing to absorb the other cities. The Sumerian side was a score of more or less independent city-states — Uruk, Umma, Lagash, Ur, Eridu, Kish — each with its own militia, its own walls and its own temple economy, administered by an ensi who supervised municipal affairs; their kings were only kings of their own cities and had no power to order the troops of another. To the east lay Elam with Anshan and Susa, on the middle Euphrates stood Mari, and in the northern mountains were the clans of Subartu together with northern kin of the Akkadians themselves. How the war was decided therefore settled whether Mesopotamia would go down the road of a league of city-states or the road of an empire.
people: 薩爾貢是這場戰爭的主角。蘇美爾王表說他是園丁之子、原基什王烏爾扎巴巴的持杯人，因無王族血統而被拔擢；阿卡德人的傳說則稱他「生而父母不識」，其母將他棄於河中卻未淹死。他留下的原文銘文今已不存，現存的是古巴比倫時期的抄本，例如尼普爾出土的立像基座銘文（殘片CBS 13972與Ni 3200），其中他自稱「阿卡德之王、伊什塔拉的監察者、吉什之王、阿努的受膏者、大地之王、恩利爾的總督」。他奪位後擊敗烏魯克王盧伽爾-扎吉西，把對方「用頸圈牽到恩利爾的門前」，這是阿卡德政權合法性的第一次公開宣示。他有王后塔什露圖，長女恩赫杜安娜是烏爾的南納女神大祭司，寫下《伊什塔拉的頌揚》與《南舍頌》，是已知最早有署名的女性作者。他的兒子瑞穆什、瑪尼什圖蘇相繼繼位，孫子納拉姆辛承其志並在軍隊中獲得神格待遇；曾孫沙爾卡利沙瑞為末代君主。帝國的敵手除了盧伽爾-扎吉西，還有北方山地與東方的埃蘭人。薩爾貢的晚年形象被後世新亞述的《美索不達米亞編年史》與阿卡德王表改寫成英雄傳說，宮廷寫手替他補上出生神話、航海蓬特與在庫爾之外的行軍，把一次政變式的建國寫成神授的偉業。
peopleEn: Sargon is the protagonist of this war. The Sumerian King List makes him the son of a gardener and the former cup-bearer of Ur-Zababa of Kish, raised to office precisely because he had no royal blood; Akkadian tradition instead has him 'born of parents who did not know him', his mother casting him into the river where he did not drown. The original inscriptions he left behind are lost, and what survives are Old Babylonian copies, such as the pedestal inscription of the statue from Nippur (fragments CBS 13972 and Ni 3200), in which he styles himself 'Sargon, king of Akkad, overseer of Inanna, king of Kish, anointed of Anu, king of the land, governor of Enlil'. After his seizure of the throne he defeated Lugal-zage-si, king of Uruk, and led the prisoner 'in a collar to the gate of Enlil', the first public assertion of Akkadian legitimacy. His wife was Tashlultum; his elder daughter Enheduanna, high priestess of the moon god Nanna at Ur, composed the Exaltation of Inanna and the hymn to Nanshe, and is the earliest female author known by name. His sons Rimush and Manishtushu succeeded him in turn, and his grandson Naram-Sin carried on the work and was given divine status in his own army; his great-grandson Shar-kali-sharri was the last ruler of the dynasty. Beside Lugal-zage-si, the empire's adversaries included the peoples of the northern mountains and Elam to the east. Sargon's later image was rewritten by the Neo-Assyrian scribes of the Mesopotamian Chronicles and by the Akkadian King List into a hero legend: court writers added the birth myth, the voyage to Punt and the campaigning beyond the mountains, turning a coup at Akkad into a divinely sanctioned achievement.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛是早王朝的典型兵器：銅質矛頭綁在木桿上，用來守城，也用來收復失地。同一型制的兵器正是阿卡德步兵的骨幹。兩河流域出土的青銅器時代長矛，多為有套筒的葉形銅矛頭，套在約兩公尺長的木桿上，柄尾加一枚尾錐以便插地支撐；步兵列陣時把矛豎在身前，長矛與圓形柳條盾、銅盔配合成密集的矛牆，卡面上的長矛正是這一體系的代表。阿卡德人手上還有：短小的銅匕首與短劍；頸部寬闊如鴨嘴的鴨嘴斧，是阿卡德時期最具代表性的銅斧；銅鎚頭、投石索；以及早王朝以來就出現在戰陣上的弓。防具方面有圓形藤盾，中央常嵌銅鈕；尼普爾出土的成組銅盔，說明部分兵員另有頭部防護。機動方面有四輪實心車輪的輕型馬車，由驢或野驢拉動，王與高級軍官乘車居中指揮，步兵列陣於車陣兩側。攻城時以撞木與銅口工具破壞城牆與城門，渡河與沿海作戰則靠船：薩爾貢在阿卡德營建船塢，打造了船首尖銳的戰船，可沿幼發拉河與波斯灣方向運兵。銅料來自迪爾蒙與西奈，杉木來自阿馬努斯山區，長矛與斧頭的木柄與金屬都靠這條遠程供給線維持。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is the typical weapon of the early dynastic period: a copper head bound to a wooden shaft, used to hold a wall and later to reconquer lost ground. A weapon of the same family was the backbone of the Akkadian infantry. The bronze-age spears recovered in Mesopotamia are usually leaf-shaped copper heads with a socket, fitted to a wooden shaft about two metres long, with a butt-spike added so the weapon can be planted in the ground and braced; in the line the spearman held the shaft upright in front of him, and spear, round wicker shield and copper helmet together formed a dense wall of points, of which the spear on the card is the representative. The Akkadians also carried short copper daggers and short swords; the 'duck-bill axe', broad and flared at the neck like a duck's bill, the most characteristic copper axe of the Akkadian period; mace-heads and slings; and the bow, which had been in the battle line since the early dynastic period. For protection there were round wicker shields, often with a copper boss in the centre, and sets of copper helmets from Nippur show that part of the troops had head cover as well. For mobility there were light four-wheeled chariots with solid disc wheels, drawn by donkeys or onagers, in which the king and senior officers rode at the centre of command while the infantry formed up on either side of the chariot line. In sieges, sledge-hammers and copper-tipped picks were used to break walls and gates; for movement on the rivers and along the coast there were boats, for Sargon built shipyards at Akkad and had warships with sharpened prows that could carry troops down the Euphrates and towards the Persian Gulf. The copper came from Dilmun and Sinai, the cedar from the Amanus range, and both the wooden hafts and the metal of the spears and axes were kept supplied by that long-distance line.
tactics: 阿卡德的戰術核心是「以矛列陣、以車為鋒」。步兵排成緊密橫隊，矛尖前指，盾與矛交錯，數層人疊成一堵可以緩衝箭矢的活牆；一旦接戰，前列矛手纏鬥糾纏，後排以長矛越肩刺擊，縱深由號令調換。薩爾貢在王璽上自誇「不識敵人」的五千四百人，顯示其核心是常備職業兵，而非一次性的城邦徵召。車隊是機動力量，也是戰場上的指揮中樞：國王乘車在陣前巡視，戰車衝散潰退的散兵，步兵則依車陣的進退調整射界與隊形。攻城是這場戰爭的另一面：烏魯克、烏瑪、勒加什的城牆接連被拆，城門破壞後步兵長驅入城，入城之後必須逐段清剿街巷與神廟區，因此隊形由密集橫隊轉為縱隊搜索。遠征方面，薩爾貢把幼發拉河與底格里斯河當作運兵線，北方遠征至阿馬努斯杉林與「銀山」一線，東征則深入蘇巴爾圖山區；後勤靠神廟莊園與阿卡德中央供應的穀物，配以柱形印章封緘的帳目與統一度量衡，使遠征隊伍不必就地徵糧，也不必帶著整座城市的物資隨行。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Akkadian army was to fight in a line of spears with the chariot as the leading edge. The infantry stood in close-packed ranks, points forward, shields and spears interleaved, several files deep so as to form a living wall that could absorb arrows; once engaged, the front files grappled and fought while the files behind thrust over their shoulders, and the depth of the formation was shifted by command. Sargon's boast on the royal seal of 5,400 men 'who knows no enemy' shows a core of regular professional soldiers rather than a one-off levy of the city-states. The chariot corps was the mobile element and the command hub on the field: the king rode out in front of the line, the chariots broke up fleeing stragglers, and the infantry adjusted its range of fire and its order according to the movement of the chariot line. Siege was the other face of this war: the walls of Uruk, Umma and Lagash were broken one after another, and once a gate was open the infantry drove straight in, after which the fighting moved street by street through the quarters and the temple precincts, so the formation changed from close ranks into columns searching ahead. On campaign, Sargon used the Euphrates and the Tigris as lines of communication, driving north to the cedar forest of the Amanus and the 'Silver Mountain', and pushing east into the Subartean highlands. Logistics rested on the temple estates and on grain supplied from the Akkadian centre, with accounts sealed by cylinder seals and standardised measures, so that a distant column did not have to forage on the spot or drag a whole city's stores along with it.
data: 阿卡德建國的年代，主流的中期年表定於前二三三四年，薩爾貢在位至前二二七九年前後；短年表與長年表的推算各有一兩百年的出入，現代研究多取中期年表。蘇美爾王表各抄本給他的在位年數從四十年到五十五、五十六年不等，學者多認為是傳抄脫字所致，可靠的實測只有四個年名，內容分別是征西馬魯姆、毀埃蘭西部烏魯阿與阿勞瓦、毀埃蘭、毀馬里，說明薩爾貢的東征與北征是分年進行的。軍力方面，王璽銘文的「五千四百人」是唯一具體的建軍數字，與後世烏爾早期王室的用兵規模同屬早期編制的數量級；「大地之王」與後來「四境之王」的頭銜意味著帝國以整個美索不達米亞為範圍，遠征線最遠抵地中海東岸的杉林與銀山，航線則經波斯灣達迪爾蒙。疆域面積與人口沒有可靠數字，學界只以「涵蓋美索不達米亞大部及部分黎凡特、胡里安與埃蘭土地」概括。度量方面，阿卡德時期形成以銀舍客勒約八點七五克為單位的重量體系，銅、大麥與穀物各有定比，便於以定量配給維持遠征軍隊。須留意的是，所有直接材料都是後世抄本：尼普爾立像基座銘文屬古巴比倫時期的摹寫，美索不達米亞編年史屬新亞述時期的抄錄，其中若干記述，如航海蓬特與在庫爾之外的行軍，是否反映史實，學界仍有爭論。本戰役的確切月份無文獻可考，卡面取四月，是按兩河流域春汛退水、田事方興的傳統出征時令安排的。
dataEn: The date of the Akkadian foundation is placed at 2334 BC in the middle chronology, with Sargon's reign running to about 2279 BC; the short and long chronologies differ by a hundred or two hundred years, and modern work generally prefers the middle chronology. Copies of the Sumerian King List give his reign as anywhere from forty years to fifty-five or fifty-six, which scholars mostly attribute to scribal corruption; only four year-names are actually attested, and their contents — the campaign against Simurrum, the destruction of Uru'a and Arawa in western Elam, the destruction of Elam, and the destruction of Mari — show that his eastern and northern campaigns were carried out year by year. On the military side, the '5,400 men' of the royal seal inscription is the only concrete figure we have for the size of the army, and belongs to the same order of magnitude as the forces of the early Ur kings. The titles 'king of the land' and, later, 'king of the four quarters' imply a realm measured against all of Mesopotamia, with the line of campaign reaching the cedar forest and the Silver Mountain on the eastern Mediterranean coast, and the line of sail running through the Persian Gulf to Dilmun. There are no reliable figures for area or population; scholarship summarises the extent only as 'most of Mesopotamia together with parts of the Levant, Hurrian territory and Elam'. In the sphere of measurement, the Akkadian period produced a weight system built on a silver shekel of about 8.75 grams, with fixed ratios for copper, barley and grain, which made it possible to maintain a distant army on quantified rations. It must be remembered that all direct material is a later copy: the Nippur pedestal inscription is an Old Babylonian copy, and the Mesopotamian Chronicles are Neo-Assyrian transcriptions, and whether certain passages among them, such as the voyage to Punt and the campaigning beyond the mountains, reflect history is still debated. The month field on this card takes January of the accession year as a representative value, because the sources record no certain month.
cause: 一場這樣的戰爭，必須從阿卡德、基什與烏魯克三方的政治崩解說起。基什王烏爾扎巴巴曾經是蘇美爾的霸主，他把薩爾貢從持杯之職調為園丁，以示貶抑；城邦聯盟崩解之後，烏魯克王盧伽爾-扎吉西打敗蘇美爾諸城，獨攬大權，成為薩爾貢的直接對手。薩爾貢並無王族血統，卻以軍功與神授的名分奪位：阿卡德王表稱他「受天之命」，立像銘文自稱「阿努的受膏者」，把政變寫成神的安排，藉此繞開血統問題。經濟上，阿卡德位於幼發拉河與卡班運河交會處，是灌溉農業與河運的交點，控制它就控制了蘇美爾剩餘產品的集散；銅來自迪爾蒙與西奈，杉木來自地中海東岸的杉林，守卫這兩條長距離貿易線，是阿卡德人推行集權的直接經濟動機。外壓同樣真實：北方山地有蘇巴爾圖的氏族與游牧集團，沙漠地帶有阿摩利人，東面埃蘭的安尚虎視眈眈，帝國未建而邊界已被人窺視。最後還有一層結構性的原因：蘇美爾的城邦神廟經濟本就把剩餘吸進廟產，戰爭使薩爾貢得以用中央軍隊與統一度量衡接管這些資源，戰爭因此同時也是國家形成的手段。
causeEn: A war of this kind has to be read from the political collapse of Akkad, Kish and Uruk. Ur-Zababa of Kish had been the hegemon of Sumer, and he moved Sargon from the cup-bearer's office to that of gardener as a mark of disgrace; when the league of city-states fell apart, Lugal-zage-si of Uruk defeated the other Sumerian cities and gathered their power into his own hands, becoming Sargon's direct rival. Sargon had no royal blood, yet he seized the throne on the strength of military service and a claim of divine appointment: the Akkadian King List has him 'ordained of heaven', and the pedestal inscription styles him 'anointed of Anu', presenting a coup as the will of the gods and so sidestepping the question of lineage. Economically, Akkad stood at the junction of the Euphrates and the King Canal, the meeting point of irrigated agriculture and river transport, and whoever held it held the collection of Sumerian surplus; the copper came from Dilmun and Sinai, the cedar from the cedar forest of the eastern Mediterranean, and to guard these two long-distance trade lines was the direct economic motive behind Akkadian centralisation. External pressure was no less real: in the northern mountains were the clans and herders of Subartu, in the desert the Amorites, and in the east Anshan of Elam watched and waited; the empire was not yet built, but its borders were already being eyed. At the bottom there was a structural cause as well: the temple economies of the Sumerian cities had always drawn surplus into temple estates, and the war allowed Sargon to take those resources over with a central army and standardised measures. The war was therefore at the same time a means of state formation.
impact: 阿卡德帝國留下的第一樣東西，是「帝國」這個做法本身。此前七個世紀的蘇美爾由數十個互相競爭的城邦組成，每一城有自己的城牆、自己的神、自己的民兵；前二三三四年之後，這些城邦第一次被同一支常備軍、同一套帝國官署與同一種通用行政語言（阿卡德語）綁在一起，而蘇美爾語退守到神廟與祭祀的領域。帝國還第一次把多族裔的部隊編入同一支軍隊，王室控制的兵員包括阿卡德人、蘇美爾人與北方山地部眾，這在後世的亞述與巴比倫帝國成為常態。第二是行政技術的標準化：統一的重量與容積單位、以柱形印章與封泥記帳的物資調度，以及王權對神廟莊園的直接支配，都成為後來烏爾第三王朝與古巴比倫的行政底盤。第三是政治語言：納拉姆辛的「四境之王」稱號，與其勝利石碑上並列的星、日、月符號，把王權抬到人與神之間的模糊地帶，成為後來亞述王自稱「神的代理人」的先聲。第四是文獻層面的：薩爾貢的傳奇、恩赫杜安娜的頌歌與納拉姆辛的戰場頌辭，構成青銅時代最早的一批帝國史材料。帝國本身卻沒有長壽：其崩潰反而說明大型多族帝國的內部張力——內亂、邊疆脫離與北方外敵同時作用，帝國終於前二一九三年崩解；其後古提人入主、烏爾第三王朝的烏爾納姆重建統一，帝國的行政形式卻在廢墟上延續了近兩千年。
impactEn: The first thing the Akkadian Empire left behind was the practice of empire itself. For seven preceding centuries Sumer had been made up of dozens of competing city-states, each with its own walls, its own god and its own militia; after 2334 BC those cities were bound together for the first time by a single standing army, a single imperial administration and a single administrative language (Akkadian), while Sumerian retreated to the temples and the liturgy. The empire also enrolled troops of different peoples into one army for the first time, the royal forces drawing on Akkadians, Sumerians and northern mountaineers, and this became the norm in the later Assyrian and Babylonian empires. Second, the standardisation of administrative technique: uniform units of weight and volume, the accounting and transfer of goods under cylinder seals and clay sealings, and the direct control of the king over temple estates, all became the administrative floor on which the Third Dynasty of Ur and Old Babylonia later stood. Third, political language: the title 'king of the four quarters' taken by Naram-Sin, together with the star, sun and crescent shown side by side on his victory stele, lifted kingship into the hazy zone between men and gods, and anticipated the later Assyrian claim to be the agent of the god. Fourth, on the documentary level, the legend of Sargon, the hymns of Enheduanna and the battlefield panegyric of Naram-Sin form the earliest body of imperial historical writing of the bronze age. The empire itself, however, was not long-lived: its collapse demonstrates instead the internal strains of a large multi-ethnic empire, with civil war, secession on the frontiers and northern invaders all acting at once, so that the empire broke up in 2193 BC. The Gutians then took over, and Ur-Nammu of the Third Dynasty of Ur rebuilt the unity; the administrative forms of the empire nevertheless carried on for close to two millennia on top of the ruins.
result: 前二三三四年的統一戰役以阿卡德方的徹底勝利告終。薩爾貢在烏魯克城下取勝，拆毀城牆，把盧伽爾-扎吉西套上頸圈押到恩利爾門前；接著取烏爾、埃寧馬爾，蹂躪勒加什直至海邊，攻破烏瑪，並以「在海中洗滌兵器」自記海疆已盡臣服於手。北方他取馬里與伊布拉，一直打到杉林與「銀山」；東方則分年征西馬魯姆、埃蘭、馬里與烏魯阿-阿勞瓦，埃蘭一度被毀。建國之後，他營建阿卡德城，興造船塢與尖首戰船，並留下建城、洪水與城被水淹後重建的記載——這一段出自新亞述的《美索不達米亞編年史》，史實性存疑。他本人最後死在軍營：編年史記他在「齊姆里之地」的戰役中陣亡，遺體以輿櫃抬回阿卡德。帝國並未隨他而終：瑞穆什、瑪尼什圖蘇、納拉姆辛、沙爾卡利沙瑞四代相承，疆域維持近一個半世紀，納拉姆辛更兩度打到北方山道與東方；前二一九三年王朝斷絕，蘇美爾人迎回盧伽爾-扎吉西的舊邦，其後有烏爾納姆重建。總結這一場：阿卡德以常備軍與行政組織把城邦聯盟改造成帝國，贏的是組織，輸的則是王朝的壽命。
resultEn: The unification campaign of 2334 BC ended in a complete victory for Akkad. Sargon won before Uruk, tore down its walls and led Lugal-zage-si away in a collar to the gate of Enlil; he then took Ur and E-Ninmar, laid waste to Lagash as far as the sea, broke open Umma, and put on record that he 'washed his weapons in the sea', so that the sea's coast was subject to him. In the north he took Mari and Ibla and drove as far as the cedar forest and the 'Silver Mountain'; in the east he campaigned year by year against Simurrum, Elam, Mari and Uru'a and Arawa, and Elam was destroyed at one point. After the foundation he built up the city of Akkad, established shipyards and sharp-prowed warships, and left a record of building the city, of a flood, and of the city being swept away and rebuilt — a passage that comes from the Neo-Assyrian Mesopotamian Chronicles and whose historicity is doubtful. He himself died in a camp: the chronicle records that he was killed on campaign in the land of Zimri and that his body was brought back to Akkad in a palanquin. The empire did not end with him: Rimush, Manishtushu, Naram-Sin and Shar-kali-sharri followed in turn, the realm held for close to a century and a half, and Naram-Sin campaigned twice toward the northern passes and the east; in 2193 BC the dynasty ended, the Sumerians restored the old polity of Lugal-zage-si, and later Ur-Nammu rebuilt the unity. Summing up this war: Akkad turned a league of city-states into an empire through a standing army and an administrative organisation; what it won was organisation, and what it lost was the life of the dynasty.
